name: Haus Rinner Rosa
beschreibung: The Haus Rinner Rosa is situated in a peaceful side street in the picturesque village of Oetz at the entrance to Tyrol's Ötztal. The welcoming guest rooms, furnished with classic solid alpine wood, offer modern en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, and balconies taking in views of the Ötztal and Stubai Alps. A varied breakfast buffet showcasing regional delicacies greets visitors each morning in the cheerful dining room. The base terminal of the Acherkogelbahn gondola into the family ski and hiking area of Hochoetz, along with the historic village centre, is just a brief walk away. In summer, the famously warm, forest-fringed Lake Piburg provides idyllic swimming and walking opportunities.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy bed and breakfast in Oetz at the entrance to the Ötztal with traditional rooms and close to Lake Piburg.
